title: Customer Sales Advisor - German Speaking
description:
We are looking for a native German speaker or a fluent German-speaking multilingual candidate with excellent written and verbal communication skills and will be confident communicating professionally in both German and English.

Do you have a solid background in the automotive industry and enjoy helping others with technical advice?
We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced automotive professional to join our team as a Customer Sales Advisor.

Whether you come from a parts sales environment or are a former workshop technician looking to move into a customer-facing role, your knowledge and experience will help our customers get the right solution, first time.

About us

We re based conveniently between Nottingham and Derby, right by the entrance to Shipley Country Park 700 acres of stunning countryside that our team enjoys for walking, biking, and a relaxed café lunch break.

What we re looking for

We require candidates with:
- Experience in the automotive industry (parts sales, service desk, or workshop background ideal).
- A strong understanding of vehicle components, systems, and fault symptoms.
- Proven ability to communicate technical information clearly to customers.
- Experience in customer-facing or telephone-based roles preferred.
- Fluency in German and English verbal and written communication skills.

What you ll be doing
- Handling inbound and outbound calls with customers and trade partners.
- Advising customers on suitable parts, services, and solutions.
- Identifying opportunities to upsell products and services.
- Managing live chat and online enquiries.
- Creating invoices, proformas, credit notes, and courier labels.
- Maintaining accurate customer and order records.
- Acting as the link between customers and our internal technical teams to resolve issues quickly.
- Communicating with German-speaking and international customers.

What we offer
- Full on-the-job training, with continuous development throughout your career at ECU Testing Ltd.
- 32 days holiday per year (including bank holidays).
- Monthly sales bonus.
- Free work uniform and PPE.
- Free takeaway meal every Friday ( Fat Friday ).
- Access to a fully equipped company gym.
- Birthday gifts, Christmas party (paid for by the MD), and annual team-building days.
- Excellent in-house career progression opportunities.

If you are an automotive professional and want to bring your technical expertise into a rewarding customer-focused role, we d love to hear from you.

Apply online today.

title: Sales Advisor
description:
Job Role: Sales Advisor

Location: Chesterfield

Salary: 32,000 - 35,000 + Bonus

Are you passionate about sales and customer service? This is an exciting new opportunity with our client, who is seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Sales Advisor to join their team in Chesterfield!

Role Overview:

As a Sales Advisor, you will play a crucial role in winning and retaining business. Your primary responsibilities will include quoting and booking calls, following up on open quotes the same day, and working through structured calling lists. You will engage with lapsed accounts, follow up with online enquiries, and new prospects to generate demand and close deals.

Key Responsibilities:
- Quote and book in customer calls
- Handle pricing inquiries confidently.
- Chase open quotes the same day to ensure timely shipping.
- Record outcomes of each follow-up accurately, maintaining detailed notes
- Utilise weekly lists of lapsed accounts, online searchers, and new prospects
- Efficiently serve trade counter collections and ensure daily collections are prepared in advance.
- Managing existing customer accounts, identifying growth opportunities
- Building strong working relationships with customers
- Manage the shared inbox and allocate online orders to meet daily standards.

Key Skills and Experience:
- Natural sales ability on the phone, with a willingness to learn.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy in order processing.
- Excellent organisational skills, ensuring tasks are completed and notes are kept.
- Proficiency in office systems
- Team-oriented mindset

This is an exciting opportunity to become part of an organisation that offers a supportive environment where team collaboration is encouraged! If you have a passion for sales and a desire to make an impact, this position is for you!

This is a full time, office based permanent opportunity working Monday to Friday 8:00am - 4:00pm or 9:00am - 5:00pm and one in every four Saturdays 9:00am - 1:00pm.

Adecco is a disability- confident employer. It is important to us that we run an inclusive and accessible recruitment process to support candidates of all backgrounds and all abilities to apply. Adecco is committed to building a supportive environment for you to explore the next steps in your career. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage, please let us know and we will be happy to support you.

Adecco acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. The Adecco Group UK & Ireland is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

By applying for this role your details will be submitted to Adecco. Our Candidate Privacy Information Statement explaining how we will use your information is available on our website.

title: Sales Advisor
description:
Parts Sales Advisor
Location: Derbyshire (commutable from Derby & Nottingham)
Competitive Salary + Excellent Benefits

Are you passionate about the automotive industry and enjoy helping customers solve technical challenges?

We're recruiting on behalf of a well-established and growing automotive business for a Parts Sales Advisor to join their friendly and supportive team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong customer service skills, a keen interest in the automotive sector and a passion for delivering first-class customer support. You'll be joining a fast-paced environment where you can develop your technical knowledge and build a long-term career.

The Role

As a Parts Sales Advisor, you'll be the first point of contact for customers, providing expert advice and helping them identify the correct automotive parts and solutions to meet their needs.

You'll work closely with internal teams to ensure a smooth customer journey, from initial enquiry through to order completion, while delivering a high standard of service throughout.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage inbound and outbound customer calls in a professional and timely manner.
- Provide technical advice and support relating to automotive parts and products.
- Respond to customer enquiries via telephone, email and live chat.
- Identify opportunities to recommend additional products and services.
- Process customer orders, quotations, invoices, credit notes and proformas.
- Create and manage courier bookings and shipping documentation.
- Maintain accurate customer records using internal systems.
- Liaise with technical departments to resolve customer queries efficiently.
- Deliver an outstanding customer experience at every stage.

About You

We're looking for someone who has:
- Previous experience in a customer service, sales support, parts advisory or contact centre environment.
- A genuine interest in the automotive industry, ideally with some knowledge of vehicle parts and components.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- A confident and professional telephone manner.
- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
- Good IT skills and the ability to learn new systems quickly.
- The ability to multitask, prioritise workloads and remain calm under pressure.
- A proactive, customer-focused approach and a willingness to learn.

Previous automotive parts experience would be advantageous, but candidates with strong customer service skills and a genuine interest in the industry are also encouraged to apply.

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary.
- Comprehensive training and ongoing professional development.
- Genuine opportunities for career progression.
- Generous annual leave entitlement.
- Company pension.
- Employee wellbeing initiatives, including access to on-site fitness facilities.
- Regular team events and company social activities.
- A supportive and collaborative working environment.

Interested?

If you're a confident communicator with a passion for customer service and an interest in the automotive industry, we'd love to hear from you.

Whether you're already working in automotive parts or looking to take the next step in your customer service career, this could be a fantastic opportunity to join a successful and growing business.

Apply today with your updated CV.
